title: Will Teens Just Stay Up Later If School Starts Later? California Says No.
summary_en: Every time a school district considers a later start time, the same objection surfaces: teens will just stay up later. It's an understandable worry. But now we have national data that suggest otherwise.
title_cn: Will Teens Just Stay Up Later If School Starts Later? California Says No.

title: Care Forward Colorado and Career Advance Colorado: Financial Aid Programs to Support Workforce Credentialing in High-Demand Fields
summary_en: The authors evaluate the implementation and impacts of two Colorado financial aid programs: Care Forward and Career Advance. These programs provided financial support to individuals pursuing certificates and associates degrees in high-demand fields.
title_cn: Care Forward Colorado and Career Advance Colorado: Financial Aid Programs to Support Workforce Credentialing in High-Demand Fields

title: If AI Takes the Jobs, Who Will Pay the Taxes?
summary_en: This research brief describes the fiscal implications for federal revenue in scenarios in which artificial intelligence and automation technologies replace human labor and summarizes policy options to stabilize the tax base.
title_cn: If AI Takes the Jobs, Who Will Pay the Taxes?
